topic: Identify the ancient Greek poet traditionally credited with the Iliad
core_question: Which ancient Greek poet is traditionally credited with composing the Iliad? (secondary: Who was the first person to run a marathon distance in under two hours?)
answer_summary: Homer, the ancient Greek poet traditionally credited with composing the Iliad (and the Odyssey).; after the topic shift: The answer must name Eliud Kipchoge, who ran 1:59:40 in the 2019 INEOS 1:59 Challenge, as the first person to break the two-hour marathon barrier.
